identity: Shading profiles + scale constants for the Graphics Pipeline Test story. A design part carries a `color` (a palette key or literal hex) and a `shade` (one of these profile names); the two are independent.

glow.note: light source: flat + survives every LOD cull

matte.note: even mid-contrast, no hot highlight - most cloth

deep.note: strong core shadow, modest sheen - leather, coats, hull

sheen.note: soft body, bright highlight strip - glass, satin, plastic

metal.note: hard shadow and hard specular - bare metal
